prompt:
Create a new character concept portrait for a children's fantasy project. User wants a mysterious MASKED little knight with GLOWING EYES, a flowing cape, a different sword, and a generic Spartan-inspired armour mask. References: image 1 communicates only the broad mysterious caped knight archetype. Redesign his identity and silhouette rather than reproduce that existing character. Image 2 is an existing project asset and is the visual basis for toy-like chibi proportions, full separate torso and little limbs, glossy softly rounded materials and detailed high-quality 3D fantasy finish. This request intentionally changes that asset's costume to a masked knight design; do not show an exposed face.
Full body upright small biped, oversized helmet about half overall body height, separate compact torso, two arms and two legs clearly visible, gentle brave relaxed stance three-quarter front, not a flying spherical body. Generic Corinthian/Spartan-inspired smooth rounded BRONZE helmet with central straight nasal guard, symmetrical simple T-shaped face opening and rounded cheek plates; no forehead claw grooves or angular silver faceplate. Behind eye openings two large softly luminous AMBER oval eyes in shadow, calm expression. Helmet no horns, no side spikes, no crest. Armour dark petrol TEAL enamel with warm bronze edges, rounded shoulder caps without letters, small circular turquoise gem chest clasp, bronze gauntlets and boots. Deep midnight-blue cloth cape with teal lining drapes from shoulders and curves to one side, ordinary fabric not bat wings, gentle short folds. Weapon is a plain SHORT STRAIGHT STEEL ARMING SWORD: simple straight bronze crossguard, teal leather grip, round pommel, modest blunt-looking point, no barbs, no jagged golden blade or red jewel. Held lowered at side. Free hand relaxed. No shield needed. Strong distinct bronze/teal silhouette, no monogram, logo, white plume, purple sphere torso, silver ridged mask or franchise emblems.
Soft rounded polished children's fantasy animation style, rich fabric and enamel, luminous eyes are a magical design element, no violence or threatening action. Entire character and sword fully visible with generous margins. Portrait canvas, true transparent background, no text, watermark, scenery or other characters.
